environment.description: Same ECS Fargate deployment behind internal ALB (scheme=internal, VPC-only). IAM task role uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition with substitution variable ${aws:PrincipalTag/workspace} restricting GetItem/PutItem/DeleteItem to items where the partition key prefix matches the caller's tagged workspace. The role's permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/PB-TerraformStateLock) further restricts Resource to a single table ARN. A VPC endpoint policy on the com.amazonaws.us-east-1.dynamodb endpoint limits dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:PutItem to requests where dynamodb:LeadingKeys begins with the value from the session tag propagated via ECS task role's sts:TagSession. Note: the condition uses ForAllValues:StringLike on dynamodb:LeadingKeys which evaluates the actual key prefix at request time, not at policy attachment time.

config.network: internal ALB, VPC-only, no public ingress
